question:
The following line graph shows the quantity of digital watches manufactured by two companies X and Y over 6 years (from 2014 to 2019). Answer the given question based on the line graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08a7434a9b1691abbd427270bcf603ba0e75bc3609de2f5640b1e78c7cfab5b0.png] 

In which year is the absolute difference between the quantity of watches manufactured by company X and company Y the maximum?
solution:
**Given:**

A line graph showing the quantity of digital watches manufactured by two companies X and Y over 6 years (from 2014 to 2019) is given.

**Formula used:**

Absolute difference = bigger value - smaller value

**Calculation:**

The absolute difference between the quantity of watches manufactured by company X and company Y, in 2014 = 120 - 105 = 15

In 2015, 108 - 85 = 23

In 2016, 130 - 100 = 30

In 2017, 115 - 80 = 35

In 2018, 125 - 108 = 17

In 2015, 160 - 150 = 10

**∴ The absolute difference between the quantity of watches manufactured by company X and company Y is maximum in 2017.**
